# MyBatis 3 API & XML Reference Catalog (Unofficial · PNI501 + Drawlib Demo)

> Unofficial bilingual (English/Japanese) API & XML reference catalog for MyBatis 3 v3.6.0 — Core Session API, Mapper Annotations, XML Configuration & Mapper DTD/XSD Elements, SQL Builder, TypeHandlers, Cache & Transaction SPIs, Plugin…

## Catalog

- [API & XML Catalog Overview](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/en/00_overview.html): Welcome to the MyBatis 3 (v3.6.0) API & XML Reference Catalog. Every public Java interface, class, annotation, SPI contract, and XML DTD/XSD element across…
- [Session & Binding API](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/en/01_session_and_binding.html): Core session management, configuration registry, streaming cursor, and dynamic mapper binding interfaces in org.apache.ibatis.session…
- [Annotations & SQL Builder](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/en/02_annotations_and_sql.html): Declarative Java mapper annotations (org.apache.ibatis.annotations, 39 source files) and programmatic SQL / JDBC execution utilities (org.apache.ibatis.jdbc…
- [XML Configuration & Mapper Elements](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/en/03_xml_config_and_mapper.html): Complete reference for MyBatis 3's two XML DTD/XSD schemas resolved offline by XMLMapperEntityResolver:
- [TypeHandlers, Cache, Transaction & DataSource](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/en/04_type_cache_tx_datasource.html): Java-to-JDBC type conversion (org.apache.ibatis.type), L1/L2 caching (org.apache.ibatis.cache), transaction boundaries (org.apache.ibatis.transaction), and…
- [Plugins, Reflection & Exceptions](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/en/05_plugin_reflection_exceptions.html): Dynamic proxy interception (org.apache.ibatis.plugin), cached JavaBean/Record reflection (org.apache.ibatis.reflection), and runtime exception hierarchy…

- [日本語 (ja)](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/ja/): MyBatis 3 (v3.6.0) API & XML リファレンスカタログへようこそ。org.apache.ibatis.* 配下のすべてのパブリック Java インターフェース・クラス・アノテーション・拡張 SPI・XML DTD/XSD 要素を左サイドバーから / キーで即座にインクリメンタル検索できます。
